summary.text: Luke Del Castillo is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 92, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 4 Democratic primary.
He says he is a community builder and nonprofit leader who previously worked in economic development.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Del Castillo said he previously served as director of place-based business development at the Middle Michigan Development Corporation, working with small businesses, downtowns and local governments.

He said he is president of the Royal Starr Arts Institute, a nonprofit that supports filmmakers and artists and runs the Royal Starr Film Festival, and that he serves on the board of the Broadway Theatre in Mount Pleasant.
He listed strengthening small towns and local economies, community-first leadership, and fighting for working people on affordability, housing, education and health care as his key messages.
